subject: Workplace Skills
title: Requesting Stretch Assignments
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Requesting Stretch Assignments.

hook.text: A junior marketer asked to lead the product launch. She was terrified. That project became her career-defining moment.

buildup.text: Stretch assignments are tasks above your current level that accelerate growth dramatically when you deliver.

discovery.text: Most bosses won't offer stretch assignments unprompted. They assume you are content unless you signal otherwise.

twist.text: Asking for a stretch is not entitlement. It is showing ambition. Bosses prefer to develop eager employees.

climax.text: Say: 'I want to grow in X area. Is there an upcoming project where I could take on more responsibility?'

punchline.text: Ask for the stretch. Growth lives outside comfort.

quiz.question: Why won't most bosses offer stretch assignments without being asked?
options: They assume you are content unless you signal ambition
Stretch assignments are only for senior employees
